note: The weekly call video: a cold open over the chart, one call every two beats, the tally against a coin, then the end card. Grandpa speaks the "voice" cues (his captions, so no subtitle layer). call-story.js plays it; the calls are the week's ideas file, written by src/answers.ts from the calls logged in data/ledger.json.
